items.followUp: Why is bromine a liquid at room temperature while iodine is a solid?

rubric.description: States that iodine exists as diatomic molecules.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying iodine as I₂ molecules.

rubric.why: Explains why iodine remains solid at room temperature.
rubric.description: States that strong intermolecular forces give iodine a melting point above room temperature.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for linking the strong intermolecular forces or higher melting point to iodine’s solid state.

modelAnswer: Iodine exists as diatomic I₂ molecules arranged in a molecular crystal.
Strong intermolecular forces give iodine a melting point above room temperature, so it is solid.

items.followUp: How can environmental education help people protect the environment?

rubric.why: States the awareness-raising objective of environmental education.
rubric.description: States that environmental education develops awareness and understanding of the environment and its problems.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying awareness or understanding of environmental issues.

rubric.why: States the practical outcome of environmental education.
rubric.description: States that it encourages people to participate in solving environmental problems or protecting the environment.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying an action-oriented objective.

modelAnswer: The main objective of environmental education is to create environmental awareness and understanding of the environment and its problems.
It encourages people to participate in solving environmental problems and protecting the environment.
